patterns.pattern: Wrapping his arms around you in a crushing bear hug, Oeru, a burly young gnoll attempts to squeeze the life out of you.
A fierce gnoll sentinel latches his jaws around your arm and grins with glee at the sound of your bones snapping within his maw.
Summoning all her strength, Chena, the healer grabs a large empty cauldron from its hook upon the wall and swings it toward your head in a wide arc.
Chena, the healer murmurs a vicious hex under her breath and tosses a green cloud of mixed herbs over you.
With a savage cry, a fierce gnoll sentinel brings his mace crashing down upon your skull.
With a savage growl, Chisulo, the razahr smith swings his forging hammer around in a wide arc before slamming it into your skull with a sickening crunch.
A fluffy arneck snorts and paws at the ground before fearlessly trampling you.
A fluffy arneck raises his head and lets out a horrific squeal that reverberates through all of Wegava.
The Mahk's tail curls in a dizzying pattern accompanied with a flurry of dazzling lights, leaving you utterly dazed.
With the grace of a dancer, Fela, Patriarch of the razahr spins in a circle and sweeps his tail at your feet, knocking you to the floor.
Toxic saliva dripping from her maw, a hulking female razahr wraps her jaws around your throat.
